messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Increased 5xx rate on inference-proxy (region: us-east-1). AlertID=INC-20260315-01

maria (oncall): acknowledged, jumping in. seeing spikes on proxy errors and backend latency. first check: are downstream GPUs healthy?

sam (sre): I see backend latency jumping at 11:02 UTC, mostly coming from embeddings pipeline (/v1/embeddings). Error ratio ~ 18% on that route, chat is ~4%.

emily-cs: customers reporting slow embeddings in support queue — ticket CS-7342 and CS-7345. they say requests hang ~10s then 5xx.

maria (oncall): ok priority: mitigate customer impact quickly. proposed mitigations: 1) apply per-endpoint quotas to limit embeddings traffic 2) increase retry budget for chat so customer-facing features keep working 3) temporarily lower embedding concurrency or disable rerank if it's amplifying load.

sam (sre): agree. I'll apply a conservative per-route limit for embeddings to reduce backend saturation. doing via admin API.

sam (sre): executing:```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/quotas/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","max_qps":15,"burst":30,"reason":"live mitigation: reduce 5xx"}'
```

ops-bot: quota-change: /v1/embeddings max_qps=15 burst=30 applied by sam at 11:05 UTC (change-id qc-6721).

akshay (infra): FYI I pushed a patch to the in-proxy circuit breaker to drop new long requests to rerank if backend latency > 500ms. that should prevent retries thrashing.

sam (sre): also adding route-level rate limiting for rerank:```json
{"route":"/v1/rerank","max_qps":5,"burst":10}
```

ops-bot: quota-change: /v1/rerank max_qps=5 burst=10 applied by sam at 11:06 UTC (change-id qc-6722).

maria (oncall): monitoring dashboards — embeddings error rate dropping?

sam (sre): watching metrics: errors down to 9% in last 2m, p95 latency on embeddings down from 3.2s to 1.1s. chat unaffected. overall 5xx rate across the cluster dropped 60%.

emily-cs: telling CS team to update customers: temporary per-endpoint quota on embeddings may cause slower throughput for batch jobs. recommending customers throttle clients and retry with backoff.

maria (oncall): any customer with higher SLAs we need to exempt or route to dedicated capacity?

emily-cs: two enterprise customers on Dedicated nodes — they are unaffected. the impacted ones are free-tier / self-serve embeddings heavy users.

sam (sre): next step: soften throttle if stable, otherwise keep limits and schedule post-incident follow-up. also enabling a short-term caching layer for repeated embeddings keys. I'll toggle cache-ttl to 60s.```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/cache/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"namespace":"embeddings","ttl_seconds":60}'
```

ops-bot: cache-change: embeddings ttl=60s applied by sam (change-id cache-431).

maria (oncall): handoff: jin is next oncall in 10m. jin, heads up — we throttled embeddings to 15 qps, rerank to 5 qps, enabled in-proxy circuit breaker for long rerank calls, and set cache TTL 60s. error rate improving but still watching.

jin (next-oncall): ack — I'll take over at 11:15 UTC. sharing runbook link and will keep observability on p95 latency and 5xx by route.

sam (sre): also kicked a canary rollback for a small change to the embeddings optimizer that rolled earlier (it increased CPU pressure). deploy-bot started rollback canary.

deploy-bot: rollback-canary: embeddings-optimizer v2.1 -> v2.0 started at 11:08 UTC, canary traffic 10%.

akshay (infra): I'm watching GPU memory and CPU. the earlier optimizer introduced a spin loop under some request shapes; rollback should help.

maria (oncall): customer impact note: affected ~3% of production traffic, primarily batch embeddings jobs; some customers experienced increased latency/5xx; no data loss reported. logging tickets: CS-7342, CS-7345.

emily-cs: updating support macros and notifying customers in-app: "We're limiting embeddings throughput temporarily to protect service stability; no data loss expected; ETA for review 30 mins."

sam (sre): timeline so far:
- 11:02 UTC: alert triggered
- 11:04 UTC: confirm embeddings route high 5xx
- 11:05 UTC: applied embeddings quota 15 qps
- 11:06 UTC: applied rerank quota 5 qps + circuit breaker
- 11:08 UTC: started rollback canary
- 11:10 UTC: metrics improving (5xx halved)

maria (oncall): jin, when you take the incident can you verify the rollback completes and then gradually relax per-route quotas? please keep chat route limits unchanged for now. also follow up with engineering to instrument per-route token counters.

jin (next-oncall): will do. plan: wait for rollback to finish and 10m stable window, then increase embeddings to 30 qps, rerank to 10 qps, and monitor. if p95 < 1.5s and 5xx < 1% we can remove throttles.

sam (sre): adding temporary watch query to ops-alerts:```sql
SELECT route, count(*) as errors, sum(case when status>=500 then 1 else 0 end) as server_errors
FROM requests
WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY server_errors DESC
```

ops-bot: alert-suppression: suppressing non-critical downstream alerts for 20m while mitigation ongoing (suppression-id sup-998).

emily-cs: any plan for long-term fixes? customers want fewer surprises.

akshay (infra): action items: 1) revert embeddings optimizer fully and add load-testing for that change 2) add dynamic per-route throttling based on backlog/latency 3) better pre-deploy canary traffic shapes for embeddings.

maria (oncall): agreed. creating postmortem stub: PM-INC-20260315-01. we'll fill root cause after rollback completes and logs analyzed.

sam (sre): 11:12 UTC: rollback canary looks healthy, successful on 10% canary. proceeding to full rollback.```bash
deploy rollback embeddings-optimizer --to v2.0 --confirm
```

deploy-bot: rollback: embeddings-optimizer rollback to v2.0 triggered at 11:13 UTC, progress 0/5 clusters -> 3/5 clusters -> 5/5 clusters completed by 11:18 UTC.

sam (sre): 11:19 UTC metrics: embeddings 5xx down to 0.8%, p95 0.9s. safe to start relaxing quotas.

jin (next-oncall): increasing embeddings to 30 qps, rerank to 10 qps now.```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/quotas/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","max_qps":30,"burst":60,"reason":"stability regained"}'

curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/quotas/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/rerank","max_qps":10,"burst":20,"reason":"stability regained"}'
```

ops-bot: quota-change: /v1/embeddings max_qps=30 burst=60 applied by jin (qc-6729).
ops-bot: quota-change: /v1/rerank max_qps=10 burst=20 applied by jin (qc-6730).

sam (sre): final check: 5xx steady <1%, latency back to normal. closing mitigation.

maria (oncall): incident status: mitigated and under monitoring. handoff complete to jin for full postmortem.

emily-cs: CS update sent to affected customers. no escalations open.

maria (oncall): postmortem owners: sam (SRE), akshay (Infra), emily (CS) — target draft in 48h. include recommendations: per-route dynamic throttles, deploy canary improvements, better observability of token-level load.

jin (next-oncall): ack — I'll keep the watch on until 12:00 UTC then update the incident channel.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 status changed to MITIGATED by maria at 11:24 UTC.

maria (oncall): closing thread for now — thanks everyone for fast coordination.
